definitions.construction: For the measured session, each name's share volume is compared with that same name's own usual level: the average of its share volume over its previous 20 trading days. The multiple printed beside a name is its volume for the measured session divided by that usual level.
definitions.floor: A name is listed only when its volume for the measured session reached at least twice its own usual level (a multiple of 2.00 or more). Every name that reaches the floor is listed, ranked by the multiple, highest first.
definitions.universe: The names measured are the stocks in the daily scoring run, which are stocks listed today, so stocks that stopped trading earlier are not in it. A name that did not trade on the measured session is not measured and shows nothing.
definitions.volume_source: Every volume on this page comes from the consolidated tape records. No other volume source is used, and a name with no consolidated-tape volume on record would show no figure.
